card.name: Scattered words in general web prose
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on assorted small words (them, is, of, that, in, more) in everyday narrative or quoted web text.

modes.label: Small words in quotes
modes.description: Pronouns and prepositions inside quoted speech or newspaper-style narrative.
modes.example: Of course Roy uses<< them>> in a modified form but just the same

card.plain: It reacts to ordinary small words in general web text with no pattern a clinician could rely on.
